```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Compute and display LOW VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 15
    And the current VTI is 20
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then a "LOW VTI" alarm should be computed and displayed
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute and display HIGH VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 25
    And the current VTI is 30
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then a "HIGH VTI" alarm should be computed and displayed
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute and display LOW VTE alarm
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 15
    And the current VTE is 20
    When the GUI computes the VTE for the current breath
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be computed and displayed

  Scenario: No alarm when VTI is within threshold
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 20
    And the current VTI is 18
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then no alarm should be computed and displayed

  Scenario: No alarm when VTE is within threshold
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 20
    And the current VTE is 18
    When the GUI computes the VTE for the current breath
    Then no alarm should be computed and displayed

  Scenario: Boundary test for VTI equal to threshold
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 20
    And the current VTI is 20
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then no alarm should be computed and displayed

  Scenario: Boundary test for VTE equal to threshold
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 20
    And the current VTE is 20
    When the GUI computes the VTE for the current breath
    Then no alarm should be computed and displayed

  Scenario Outline: Set threshold for LOW VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then a "LOW VTI" alarm should be computed and displayed
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Set threshold for HIGH VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then a "HIGH VTI" alarm should be computed and displayed
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Set threshold for LOW VTE alarm
    Given the VTE threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the GUI computes the VTE for the current breath
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be computed and displayed

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 10        |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test for threshold out-of-range
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then no alarm should be computed and displayed

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 5         |
      | 35        |
```
